shattered_gauntlet.title: Shattered Gauntlet
shattered_gauntlet.memory_text: You fell on the battlefield. Your armor crushed. You were supposed to die here. Then, a voice offered you a second chance.

herbalists_satchel.title: Tainted Sigil
herbalists_satchel.memory_text: The mark of Andras, Marquis of Discord. A burning brand on your flesh that gives you unholy speed, but drains your humanity.

voragis_inkwell.title: Vial of Void Blood
voragis_inkwell.memory_text: Andras doesn't want you to win. He wants you to rely on his power. Every time you transform, his grip on your soul tightens.

hollowed_ledger_page.title: Hollowed Vessel Ledger
hollowed_ledger_page.memory_text: A list of warriors who made this deal before you. Every single one was hollowed out, their bodies possessed by lesser demons.

candoras_tear.title: Candora's Tear
candoras_tear.memory_text: A warm stone left at a ruined altar. A quiet reminder from the Moon Knight that someone is rooting for you to reject the demon.

amalgam_core.title: Amalgam Core
amalgam_core.memory_text: This monster was Andras's previous vessel - a horrible mix of human flesh and shadow power. It's what you will turn into.

evil_eye.name: Andras (Marquis of Discord)
barks: Let them feel your wrath! Use my shadow! You are invincible when you embrace the dark!
Yes, tear them apart! Why fight as a mortal when you can be a god?
Don't hold back. Give in to the void. I am making you perfect...

moon_knight.name: The Moon Knight (Candora's Angel)
barks: Hold onto your honor, warrior! Every time you summon his flame, your soul fades.
Stay human, runner. Candora's silver light still reaches into these woods.
His gifts are a trap. Win the race, but reject his vessel.
